limitations: Browser memory evidence uses headless Microsoft Edge and the same page-to-iframe chunk protocol shape, not a physical mobile WebView.
The IndexedDB metadata reader preserves web correctness but still deserializes bounded message pages in JavaScript, so native no-body-transfer claims do not apply to web storage.
Native measurements are process working-set samples from debug test binaries and are comparative evidence, not fixed RAM guarantees.
macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS device runs were not performed because no physical-device or remote-lab authorization was requested.
